name: worker_queue
query: select count(*) filter(where status='queued' and coalesce(next_attempt_at,created_at)<now()-interval '10 minutes') as stale_queued,count(*) filter(where status='queued') as queued,count(*) filter(where status='claimed') as claimed,count(*) filter(where status='failed' and failure_disposition='terminal') as terminal_failed,extract(epoch from now()-min(created_at) filter(where status='queued')) as oldest_queued_seconds from public.packet_render_jobs
